Acer Nitro V 16S ANV16S-71-76PU
Play, create and multitask on the Acer Nitro V 16S. This specific configuration pairs an Intel Core 7 240H processor with an NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Laptop GPU, 16GB DDR5 memory and a sharp 16-inch WQXGA display with a 180Hz refresh rate.
RTX 5070 graphics for gaming and creative work

With 16GB DDR5 memory installed as one 16GB module and a 512GB PCIe NVMe SSD, this laptop is ready for games and everyday applications. The Nitro V 16S design uses a dual-fan cooling system and includes a four-zone RGB backlit keyboard.
Connectivity and everyday essentials
Connect through Killer Wi-Fi 6 or wired Gigabit Ethernet. The laptop also includes Bluetooth, a microSD card reader, an HD webcam, HDMI, three USB-A ports and a USB-C port. It comes with a 76Wh battery, 135W power adapter and Windows 11 Home Single Language.

Be the Hero of Your Story
Built for creators who capture and edit on the move. The ASUS ProArt
GoPro Edition PX13 combines extreme AMD Ryzen AI performance, 128GB
unified memory, a professional 3K Lumina OLED touchscreen and a rugged
360° convertible design.
PERFORMANCE IN MOTION
Power for Serious Creative Work
AMD Ryzen AI MAX+ 395, Radeon 8060S graphics and 128GB of unified
LPDDR5X memory deliver the performance needed for multi-layer 4K and

GEAR UP LIKE A HERO
GoPro-Inspired Design

a matching GoPro-inspired sleeve make the PX13 ready for creators who

AI POWER. NO SLOWDOWNS.

STREAMLINED CREATIVE WORKFLOW
Capture. Transfer. Organize. Edit.

StoryCube integration helps import, preview, categorize and search

Every Frame. Ultra Clear. Ultra Real.
The 13.3-inch 3K ASUS Lumina OLED touchscreen delivers 2880 × 1800

and stylus support with up to 4096 pressure levels.

Rugged 360° Convertible Design
